tools.name: search
tools.title: Search customer conversations
tools.description: Research what real people say about a product, problem or audience across Reddit, YouTube, TikTok and Facebook groups. Runs a full search: discovers threads and videos, reads their comments, extracts verbatim quotes and writes a cited answer. A query that contains a TikTok video, creator or hashtag link, a YouTube video link, a Reddit thread or subreddit link, or a Facebook group post link reads that link's own comments directly (add a question after the link to also search the topic). Waits up to `wait_seconds` and returns the answer with the top quotes when done, or the search id to resume with `get_search`. Costs credits from the BuzzSearch balance at the API rate; the exact charge is reported on completion as `credits_charged`. Check `list_searches` first: a prior search on the same topic can be reread for free.

query.description: The research question, e.g. 'what do people hate about robot vacuums'.

depth.description: quick (about a minute), deep (about three), exhaustive (longest, most comments).

sources.description: Default: reddit, youtube, tiktok. Add facebook for group discussions.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait server-side for completion before returning (0 to 55). Call again to resume.

tools.name: get_search
tools.title: Get a search
tools.description: Read a search's status, cited answer, coverage counts and top quotes. Free. Pass `turn_id` to read a specific follow-up answer, otherwise the latest turn is returned. Waits up to `wait_seconds` if the search is still running.

search_id.description: The search id returned by `search` or `list_searches`.

turn_id.description: A turn id from `search`, `ask` or `generate_hooks`. Default: the latest turn.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait server-side for completion before returning (0 to 55). Call again to resume.

tools.name: get_quotes
tools.title: Get quotes
tools.description: Verbatim customer quotes extracted by a search, filtered and paged. Free. Each quote carries a stable id, the source url, a dimension (emotional_painpoints, recurring_painpoints, desired_outcomes, failed_solutions, objections, customer_lingo), an engagement score and an emotional intensity (1 to 5). For ad copy, pull emotional_painpoints and customer_lingo sorted by intensity.

search_id.description: The search id returned by `search` or `list_searches`.

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the quote text.

tools.name: get_sources
tools.title: Get sources read
tools.description: The threads and videos a search read, with engagement, comment counts and how many quotes each produced. Free. Use it to cite a thread or pick which source's raw comments to pull.

search_id.description: The search id returned by `search` or `list_searches`.

tools.name: get_comments
tools.title: Get raw comments
tools.description: The raw comment bodies behind a completed search, grouped by thread or video, filtered and paged. Free. A search reads hundreds to thousands of comments, so filter by source, a substring, or a minimum score, and page with limit and offset.

search_id.description: The search id returned by `search` or `list_searches`.

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the comment body.

tools.name: ask
tools.title: Ask a follow-up
tools.description: Ask a new question over a completed search's corpus and get a cited answer, without searching again. Much cheaper than a new search: only the answer is metered at the API rate. Good for 'what do they say about price', 'summarize the objections', 'which phrases do they use for the problem'. Works on searches started through the API or MCP.

search_id.description: The search id returned by `search` or `list_searches`.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait server-side for completion before returning (0 to 55). Call again to resume.

tools.name: generate_hooks
tools.title: Generate ad hooks
tools.description: Write ad hooks grounded in a completed search's quotes, using BuzzSearch's hook writer: each hook opens with a callout lifted from real comments and carries a loop or promise. Metered at the API rate, no new search. Give an `angle` to steer (a product, a persona, a platform).

search_id.description: The search id returned by `search` or `list_searches`.

angle.description: Optional steer, e.g. 'TikTok UGC for a $40 posture corrector'.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait server-side for completion before returning (0 to 55). Call again to resume.

tools.name: list_searches
tools.title: List past searches
tools.description: Recent searches by the signed-in user, newest first, including ones run in the BuzzSearch app. Free. Reread a past search with get_search or get_quotes instead of paying for a new one on the same topic.

contains.description: Case-insensitive filter on the search query.

channel.description: api = started via API or MCP, web = run in the app.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.title: Get credit balance
tools.description: The user's BuzzSearch credit balance. Searches draw from it at the API rate; top up at buzzsearch.ai.

prompts.name: research
prompts.title: Research a product or audience
prompts.description: Run a BuzzSearch search and summarize the pains, desires and objections with cited quotes.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: Product, problem or audience to research.

arguments.name: depth
arguments.description: quick, deep or exhaustive. Default quick.

prompts.name: ad-script
prompts.title: Write ad scripts from research
prompts.description: Turn a completed BuzzSearch search into ad scripts grounded in real customer language.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: e.g. '30s TikTok UGC', 'Meta static headline', 'YouTube pre-roll'. Default: 30s TikTok UGC.
